newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Property for Industry buys NZ$6.7 mln warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Property for Industry buys NZ$6.7 mln warehouse.

text.p: Property for Industry Ltd said on Friday it had bought a NZ$6.7 million warehouse complex in Manukau City, Auckland.

The company said in a statement there was scope to subdivide the 14,300 square metre complex into two or three separate titles and tenancies and add significantly to the existing buildings on the site of nearly four hectares.
The lease of the existing tenant, Kraft Foods, expires in July 1997 and PFI said it was negotiating with several interested tenants. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
